lede: The biggest item this week is Mountain Village's Town Council meeting Thursday, where a first reading would shift Housing Authority fees out of municipal code into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural change to how affordable housing costs get set going forward. The county's Housing Code Update SSR also meets Tuesday, deep in the weeds on Proposition 123-funded reforms meant to clear Land Use Code obstacles to workforce housing. Wednesday's BOCC takes up a 1999 view-plain MOU with Mountain Village and Ridge HOA, and HARC weighs a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall — the building where HARC itself meets.

notable.stake: Policy vote on 'subpar bedrooms' in mitigation units affects real housing stock.
Prop 123-funded code rewrite could reshape how workforce housing gets built countywide.

Two public hearings — Curry PUD and a parcel subdivision — open for community comment.
